clips.title: The story
paras: Corruption has turned the furbolgs of Thistlefur Hold against every outsider who draws near. Their cavern den lies at the northern end of Thistlefur Village in west-central Ashenvale.

Thistlefur Hold lies at the northern end of Thistlefur Village, at the heart of the Thistlefur tribe's territory. Corruption has driven its furbolgs mad, and they attack travelers and neighbors who draw near. In the winding caverns, the tribe hoards scavenged relics, including troll charms sought by the Darkspear. Captives are kept in wooden cages deep within, among them Ruul Snowhoof, a tauren brave.
